When the signal is discharged the electric organ will be negatively loaded compared to the head and an electric field is created around the fish. ( ) A weak electric current is created also in ordinary muscle cells when they contract. ( ) The fish varies the signals by changing the form of the electric field or the frequency of the signal discharge. ( ) In species that produce weak signals, an electric organ discharge, traveling from tail to head, creates a weak electric field around the fish. ( ) It is much weaker than in species like the electric eel, which can produce 600-volt discharges that stun prey. ( ) Any other organism entering the electric field will cause a distortion that is picked up by the electric sense organs in the fish's skin.

전기 의사소통은 육상 동물에서도 보편적으로 관찰된다.
모든 물고기는 동일한 세기의 전기 신호를 사용한다.
물고기는 전기 기관으로 신호를 생성하고 전기장의 변화를 감지하여 소통한다.

questions.passage: Electric communication is mainly known in fish. The electric signals are produced in special electric organs. When the signal is discharged the electric organ will be negatively loaded compared to the head and an electric field is created around the fish. ( ) A weak electric current is created also in ordinary muscle cells when they contract. ( ) The fish varies the signals by changing the form of the electric field or the frequency of the signal discharge. ( ) In species that produce weak signals, an electric organ discharge, __________, creates a weak electric field around the fish. ( ) It is much weaker than in species like the electric eel, which can produce 600-volt discharges that stun prey. ( ) Any other organism entering the electric field will cause a distortion that is picked up by the electric sense organs in the fish's skin.
questions.stem:
다음 우리말에 맞도록 주어진 조건에 따라 영작하시오.
"꼬리에서 머리로 이동하면서"
[조건] (1) traveling, from, tail, to, head를 모두 사용 (2) 5단어로 쓸 것 (5단어) (영어로)

det.korean: 꼬리에서 머리로 이동 = traveling from tail to head
det.analysis: 원문: traveling from tail to head, creates a weak electric field
det.tip: traveling from tail to head = 꼬리에서 머리로 이동하면서
